class.name: Marker3D
class.description: Generic 3D position hint for editing. It's just like a plain [Node3D], but it displays as a cross in the 3D editor at all times.

members.member: Color of the gizmo cross that appears in the 3D editor. When set to white (the default), the gizmo uses the editor theme's axis colors (red for X, green for Y, blue for Z) to help distinguish orientation. When set to any other color, all 3 axes use the specified color, with the positive direction appearing brighter and the negative direction appearing darker.
Size of the gizmo cross that appears in the editor.

Opacity of the gizmo cross that appears in the editor. A lower value makes the gizmo more transparent, which can be useful to reduce visual clutter when the selected marker overlaps with other markers or scene elements.
